native_backtest_limit.result: The connected TakeProfit plan rejected the request; no native backtest result was produced.

candidate_outputs.target_quote_semantics: The rounded theoretical P2 target after size calculation; it may be present even if a subsequent notional or risk check rejects the order.

objective.basis: After the modeled 15 bp non-funding round-trip cost at the strategy limit fill and after tick rounding. This is an experimental interpretation of the recorded greater-than-$5 objective.
objective.funding: Excluded; actual target after funding cannot be guaranteed by this policy.

unchanged_from_p1: P1 completed-bar entry signal and higher-timeframe bias
0.20 maximum cost-to-initial-risk gate at the 15 bp scenario
one position at a time and existing three-bar entry/exit cooldown
captured tick, quantity, and minimum-notional research proxy

target_formula.rounding: Round the long target up and the short target down to the captured $0.10 tick, then verify projected net profit is strictly above $5.00.
target_formula.entry_price_basis: Rounded strategy limit price, assumed to fill completely. Actual fills can differ.
target_formula.quantity_basis: Post-rounding quantity from the existing 15 bp risk-size formula and account settings.
target_formula.known_limit: The target is account-size and execution-policy dependent; a standalone signal indicator cannot promise this net dollar result without matching sizing and fill assumptions.

historical_feasibility_result.period: 2024-10-01 through 2026-09-30 UTC, fully inspected development history
